decision.reason: [ev-52d05bff16ea] is a single changelog line saying only that HTTP bridge configuration "moved" to a ConfigMap set up by the operator. It does not say where the configuration lived before, and it names no ConfigMap, key, CRD field or setting. It also does not say whether user-supplied bridge settings are affected. So no exposure condition can be written, and nothing shows what happens to an existing KafkaBridge deployment whose operator does nothing (transparent internal change versus required migration). We need the linked PR, upgrade notes or a rendered diff of the bridge Deployment/ConfigMap to settle applicability and consequence.
